Frequency once per week · Requirements You are 20th level and your spirit weapon is in its released form

You stop carrying your power and become it. You enter Severance for 10 rounds.

Somewhere inside those ten rounds you get exactly one irreversible attack, unique to your Spirit — your Severing Art. Using it is two actions, costs nothing, and immediately ends Severance whether you want it to or not.

Its damage depends only on which round of Severance you use it in, and it decays every round: 20d6 in the first, down to 8d6 in the seventh, and it cannot be used at all after that.

Your character never calls it Final Release. A Soul Reaper calls it by their Spirit's own name for it.
